Police kill ₹1 lakh reward gangster Furqan in UP encounter

Uttar Pradesh police killed Furqan, a gangster carrying a reward of ₹1 lakh, in an encounter in Shamli. Police stated that Furqan was involved in several serious cases. During the operation, one police officer was injured. The body has been sent for post-mortem, and further legal action is being taken.
